mapper.sql: customers.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cgroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM cgroups WHERE id IN (SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY cgroup_id)) AS leadGroupName, customers.lead_code AS leadCode, customers.name AS leadName, customers.name_kh AS leadNameKh, customers.main_number AS telephone, so.id AS sourceId, so.name AS sourceName, customers.mobile_number AS mobile, customers.other_number AS alternateMobile, customers.email AS email, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(contact_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_contacts.customer_id = customers.id AND customer_contacts.is_active = 3) AS contactName, customers.latitude AS lats, customers.longitude AS longs, customers.photo AS photo, customers.address AS address, customers.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, customers.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy, customers.customer_type_id AS businessTypeId, customer_types.name AS businessTypeName, customers.customer_activity_id AS businessActivityId, customer_activities.name AS businessActivityName, customers.type AS customerType, customers.country_id AS countryId, countries.name AS countryName, customers.fax AS fax, customers.vat AS vat, customers.payment_term_id AS paymentTermId, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName, customers.payment_every AS paymentMonthly, customers.limit_balance AS limitCredit, customers.limit_total_invoice AS limitNumberInvoice, customers.recurrence AS recurrence, customers.display_term_invoice AS displayOnInvoice, customers.customer_name_in AS settingInvoiceTax, customers.house_no AS houseNo, customers.street_id AS streetId, streets.name AS streetName, customers.province_id AS provinceId, provinces.name AS provinceName, customers.district_id AS districtId, districts.name AS districtName, customers.commune_id AS communeId, communes.name AS communeName, customers.village_id AS villageId, villages.name AS villageName

FROM customers LEFT JOIN customer_types ON customer_types.id = customers.customer_type_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_sources AS so ON so.id = customers.source_id AND so.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customer_activities ON customer_activities.id = customers.customer_activity_id LEFT JOIN countries ON countries.id = customers.country_id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = customers.payment_term_id LEFT JOIN streets ON streets.id = customers.street_id LEFT JOIN provinces ON provinces.id = customers.province_id LEFT JOIN districts ON districts.id = customers.district_id LEFT JOIN communes ON communes.id = customers.commune_id LEFT JOIN villages ON villages.id = customers.village_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = customers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = customers.modified_by

mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET source_id = #{lead.sourceId}, photo = #{lead.photo}, name = #{lead.name}, name_kh = #{lead.nameKh}, latitude = #{lead.lats}, longitude = #{lead.longs}, main_number = #{lead.telephone}, mobile_number = #{lead.mobile}, other_number = #{lead.alternateMobile}, email = #{lead.email}, address = #{lead.address}, customer_type = 2, is_active = 3, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{lead.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{lead.id} AND customer_type = 2
